annotations.title: Get one race and its candidates

description: One race by id (from list_races): every public candidate with party and stage (running, nominee, on the general ballot, projected winner, lost the primary or general, withdrew), the election dates and, when decided (called, certified, or finished once the winner has taken office), the winner. A called result is an election-night projection, not a certified result. No odds or market data.
name: get_race
